content: तारक {%a.%} (-रिका|{%f.%}) [तॄ-णिच् ण्वुल्] .²1 Carrying over. .²2 Protecting, preserving, rescuing. .²3 Helping another through a difficulty. .{@-कः@} .²1 A pilot, helmsman. .²2 A deliverer, saviour. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .{@-कः, -कम्@} A boat, raft. .{@-कम्@} (also {%f.%}) .²1 The pupil of the eye; संदधे दृशमुदग्रतारकाम् <ls>R. 11. 69</ls>. .²2 The eye. .²3 A star; शान्तर्क्षग्रहतारकम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 3. 1</ls>; see तारका.
